nodes.description: Public mapping of user token balances; written without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner->spender allowances; decremented with raw arithmetic.
Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in constructor; gates init, batchSend, delegate, setTradeAddress.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Whitelist mapping consulted in ensure to bypass the sale condition check.
Max number of sales per address configured by init.
Minimum sale amount configured by init.
Maximum sale amount configured by init.
Whitelisted trading address settable only by owner through setTradeAddress.
Total token supply fixed in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, tradeAddress, pair address and canSale, otherwise enforces condition.
Public payable transfer entry point using unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic after ensure().
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value directly.
Internal view implementing sale count, min and max sale restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and payload.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only mass distribution of tokens using unchecked subtraction of the total amount.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used as a whitelist check.
Deploys token, sets owner = msg.sender, mints supply and grants infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance spending and balance transfers.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and payload, executing foreign code in this contract context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performs unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performs unchecked subtraction of spender allowance.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition that can overflow.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, compared against whitelists in ensure.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom driving all unchecked arithmetic.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter in batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length used in the unchecked balance subtraction.
Target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Calldata bytes passed to the arbitrary delegatecall.
Sale count limit assigned to _saleNum in init.
Minimum sale amount token parameter of init.
Maximum sale amount maxToken parameter of init.
New whitelisted trade address assigned in setTradeAddress.
Source address examined by the ensure whitelist branch.
Recipient address examined by the ensure whitelist branch.
Value forwarded to condition by ensure.
Source address used to read _onSaleNum in condition.
Value compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address granted allowance in approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom is gated by the ensure whitelist/condition check before moving balances.
ensure falls back to condition(), which can permanently or selectively block transfers.
ensure reads tradeAddress, allowing the owner to whitelist arbitrary senders.
ensure reads canSale mapping to bypass the sale condition entirely.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner to bypass checks.
condition reads _saleNum sale limit.
condition reads _minSale lower bound.
condition reads _maxSale upper bound.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] sale counter.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
allowance subtraction inside transferFrom is unchecked and can underflow.
balanceOf[_from] subtraction inside transferFrom is unchecked and can underflow.
balanceOf[_to] addition inside transferFrom is unchecked and can overflow.
msg.sender decides whether the allowance branch executes and is the spender of record.
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit _from argument.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender.
constructor assigns ownership and full supply to msg.sender.
delegate is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
init is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
batchSend is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
Owner-only delegate() branches into an arbitrary delegatecall.
delegatecall returns control to delegate() after executing foreign code in this storage context.
batchSend subtracts the computed total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] for each recipient in the loop.
constructor fixes totalSupply from the supplied supply value.
constructor assigns the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router address.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor for whitelist comparison.
_from parameter drives the whitelist branch and the debited balance.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter feeds the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
_tos array determines the recipients iterated in batchSend.
_value parameter drives the total calculation in batchSend.
local total is the operand of the unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
parameter a is the target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
parameter b is the raw payload passed to the delegatecall.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled by 10**decimals when assigned to _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by 10**decimals when assigned to _maxSale.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
_from of ensure is compared against owner, UNI and canSale.
_to of ensure is compared against owner for whitelist bypass.
_value of ensure is forwarded into condition for min/max checks.
_from of condition indexes _onSaleNum.
_value of condition is compared to _minSale and _maxSale.
_to of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_value of transfer is forwarded into unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender of approve receives the unrestricted allowance value.
_value of approve is written straight into the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only feeds the transferFrom whitelist check and debited balance, so it is collapsed into the transferFrom core function.
Recipient parameter is meaningful only inside transferFrom and is merged into it.
Amount parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom and is merged into that function.
Recipient array is only consumed by the batchSend loop and is merged into batchSend.
Per-recipient value is only used inside batchSend and is merged into it.
Local total is computed solely as the operand of the unchecked subtraction unsafe operation.
Address parameter is the direct target of the arbitrary delegatecall operation.
Payload parameter is the direct calldata of the arbitrary delegatecall operation.
Sale count parameter is only stored by init and is merged into init.
Minimum sale parameter is only processed by init and is merged into init.
Maximum sale parameter is only processed by init and is merged into init.
Address parameter is only written by setTradeAddress and is merged into that function.
Source address is only inspected by the ensure whitelist logic and is merged into ensure.
Recipient address is only inspected by the ensure whitelist logic and is merged into ensure.
Value parameter is only forwarded by ensure to condition and is merged into ensure.
Source address is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition and is merged into condition.
Value parameter is only compared to the sale bounds inside condition and is merged into condition.
Recipient parameter is only forwarded by transfer to transferFrom and is merged into transfer.
Amount parameter is only forwarded by transfer to transferFrom and is merged into transfer.
Spender parameter is only used to key the allowance mapping inside approve and is merged into approve.
Allowance amount parameter is only written by approve and is merged into approve.
